environment.description: Terraform state backend deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with TLS termination. Authentication is handled by an OAuth2 proxy sidecar that sets X-Authenticated-Org header. No additional request filtering or authorization middleware. ALB forwards all authenticated requests directly to the application container on port 8443.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, no WAF association
config.auth: OAuth2 proxy sidecar sets X-Authenticated-Org header
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL with 847 workspace states across 12 organizations
